message:
feat(instances): construct checked equality decisions from conversion and disjointness

Add a final Decidable Eq fallback after explicit local/global instances. Normalize endpoints through the existing source reducer before reflexive decisions; unequal compact Nat literals and constructor-disjoint endpoints receive refutations built by the existing Eq.rec/recursor reasoning path. No host comparison becomes proof authority. Feed the dictionaries into decide, by_cases, proposition conditionals and recursive Not decisions while leaving open equalities unresolved.

Add source and installed-CLI regressions for arithmetic normalization, large literals, Bool disjointness, nested negation and failure isolation. Both checking engines retain the generated proof terms. Related: fln-kpd, fln-qb5.
